يقشعر (form IVq)
# يَقْشَعِرُّ (yaqšaʕirru) /jaq.ʃa.ʕir.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# يُقْشَعَرُّ (yuqšaʕarru) /juq.ʃa.ʕar.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# يَقْشَعِرَّ (yaqšaʕirra) /jaq.ʃa.ʕir.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْشَع
